jobs.title: Senior GRC Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Jasper is the marketing agents platform, built to help enterprises orchestrate AI agents that execute marketing work at scale. Purpose-built for marketing teams, Jasper enables faster, more consistent execution across campaigns, personalization, localization, and compliance—while maintaining enterprise-grade control and governance.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S., Australia, and France.

About The Role

As a Senior GRC Lead at Jasper, you will own our Governance, Risk, and Compliance program end-to-end—building a program that scales with our AI-native products. You will step in to rebuild and maintain momentum on audits, risk management, and vendor security, partnering closely with Security, Legal, and Engineering to keep Jasper compliant and trustworthy as we grow.

Day-to-day, you will work alongside the Security team, while collaborating cross-functionally with Legal, GTM, People, and Engineering to embed compliance requirements into how the company builds and operates. You will serve as the subject-matter expert on control mapping during customer and external audits, RFPs, and enterprise sales engagements—making trust a competitive advantage for Jasper.

This fully remote role reports to the Director, Security and is open to candidates located anywhere in the continental US.

What you will do at Jasper

  • Own and drive Jasper’s compliance audits (SOC 2, ISO 27001, and similar frameworks) from readiness through certification, with a path toward ISO 42001.

  • Support GDPR and broader privacy compliance alongside the Legal team, without owning the legal interpretation of requirements.

  • Rationalize overlapping requirements across frameworks to reduce compliance burden and create a single source of truth for control ownership.

  • Serve as the subject-matter expert on control mapping during customer and external audits, RFPs, and enterprise sales engagements.

  • Respond to customer security questionnaires and support the sales and legal teams during due diligence.

  • Maintain and continuously improve the risk register, including risk identification, scoring, and remediation tracking.

  • Manage vendor and third-party risk assessments and the vendor security review process.

  • Own policy management—drafting, reviewing, and keeping security and compliance policies current.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Security, Legal, Product, Engineering, etc to embed compliance and governance requirements into how the company builds and operates.

  • Automate compliance workflows, including artifact collection for external audits, internal security compliance reviews, and continuous monitoring tasks.

  • Drive, improve, and help implement AI governance across the company and product

What you will bring to Jasper

  • AI fluency — a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, copilots, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied in the context of governance, risk, and compliance for AI-native products.

  • 8+ years of experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance, ideally at a SaaS company.

  • Deep expertise across multiple compliance and security frameworks, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and at least one regulatory framework (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, or equivalent).

  • Expertise in modern cloud-native web application development practices and related security best practices, especially in the context of GCP and frontier AI platforms.

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, or similar).

  • Experience managing a risk register and vendor risk program.

  • Strong cross-functional communication — comfortable working with Security, Legal, Product, and Engineering, and able to translate technical issues for non-technical teams.

  • Experience using AI agents, tools, and platforms to automate workflows and build tools, with sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Prior experience at a startup or fast-growing SaaS company.

  • CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or similar certification.

  • Experience scoping or pursuing ISO 42001 or other AI governance frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) and a working knowledge of Python — you don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should be fluent enough to use AI platforms to modify and run scripts, build automations, and ship small tools end-to-end.

Compensation Range

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $174,250 - $205,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage beginning on the first day for employees and their families

  • 401(k) program with up to 2% company matching

  • Equity grant participation

  • Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work

  • FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals

  • Generous budget for home office set up

  • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels as we know the more inclusive we are, the better our product will be. We are committed to celebrating and supporting our differences and that diversity is essential to innovation and makes us better able to serve our customers. We hire people of all levels and backgrounds who are excited to learn and develop their skills. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that you have reviewed and agree to Jasper's CCPA Notice to Candidates, available at legal.jasper.ai/#ccpa.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Surfaces
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Jasper is the marketing agents platform, built to help enterprises orchestrate AI agents that execute marketing work at scale. Purpose-built for marketing teams, Jasper enables faster, more consistent execution across campaigns, personalization, localization, and compliance—while maintaining enterprise-grade control and governance.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S., Australia, and France.

About The Role

Jasper has already made its shift to serving the enterprise, and this is the work that continues to strengthen that direction. Our governance domain (authentication, roles and permissions, organizations, billing) is the backbone of every customer interaction, and it needs a Staff-level engineer to own its architecture and modernization. You'll take the reins of these critical backend foundations, refactoring them to be composable, stable, and scalable, so they can power the next generation of enterprise workflows for CMOs, marketing admins, and our own Forward Deployed Engineers. This is a role for someone who wants to operate as a deep technical IC, driving architectural direction and hardening the systems that everything else depends on.

This fully remote role reports to our Director of Engineering and is open to candidates located anywhere in the continental US.

What you will do at Jasper

  • Own the architecture of our governance domain end-to-end (authentication, roles and permissions, organizations, groups, billing) and drive its modernization for scale, security, and extensibility

  • Lead the refactoring of foundational backend systems toward an AI-native architecture, ensuring they support composable, customizable workflows for enterprise customers

  • Set technical direction for authentication, authorization, and organizational modeling, balancing immediate hardening with long-term platform thinking

  • The governance domain will not be the only area you work in going forward, however it is the area we need to invest in right now with strong technical leadership

  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to translate enterprise requirements (CMOs, marketing admins, FDEs) into scalable platform capabilities

  • Mentor and elevate the engineering team, raising the bar on backend practices, code quality, and architectural rigor

  • Operate hands-on 70–80% of the time, writing and reviewing critical-path code while providing technical leadership

What you will bring to Jasper

  • AI fluency with a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied to backend engineering

  • Heavy backend experience. This is a "second rodeo" hire: you've owned complex, business-critical backend systems before and you know what it takes to harden them for enterprise scale.

  • Deep expertise in at least one of: authentication/authorization, multi-tenant systems, or billing platforms. You've designed these systems, not just maintained them.

  • Enterprise backend DNA. You've built for enterprise buyers and understand the bar that governance, compliance, and reliability demand at that scale. That kind of enterprise backend depth is exactly what we're looking for.

  • Strong architectural judgment. You can balance pragmatism with long-term platform thinking, and you know when to build vs. buy vs. refactor.

  • A track record of technical leadership as an IC. You've mentored engineers, raised the bar on code quality and practices, and driven technical direction as an individual contributor.

  • You're not looking for a purely architectural role. You want to write and review critical-path code while providing technical leadership.

  • You're excited to keep growing and leveling up as an IC. This is a deep technical role, and you want to deepen your craft and impact as both an individual contributor and technical voice.

  • Direct experience in the governance problem space: auth/authz, roles and permissions, multi-tenant organizations (nice to have)

  • Experience with billing systems and usage-based pricing models (nice to have)

  • Experience building for enterprise buyers: SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logs, compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001) (nice to have)

  • Familiarity with AI-native product development: integrating LLMs, building agentic workflows, RAG systems (nice to have)

Team & Context

This role sits in the EPD org. This group owns the application surfaces and foundational backend that every Jasper customer touches. The team is currently small but high-impact, with this hire being a key addition that will shape the architectural direction of the governance domain. You'll work closely with product, platform, and Forward Deployed Engineering teams, translating enterprise requirements into scalable platform capabilities. The broader engineering org is investing heavily in AI-native architecture, and this role is central to making that vision real for our most critical systems.

How you'll be evaluated

We'll assess candidates through a structured interview process designed to evaluate technical depth, architectural judgment, and leadership as an IC. Details will be shared with candidates during the interview process.

Compensation Range

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $238,000 - $280,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage beginning on the first day for employees and their families

  • 401(k) program with up to 2% company matching

  • Equity grant participation

  • Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work

  • FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals

  • Generous budget for home office set up

  • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels as we know the more inclusive we are, the better our product will be. We are committed to celebrating and supporting our differences and that diversity is essential to innovation and makes us better able to serve our customers. We hire people of all levels and backgrounds who are excited to learn and develop their skills. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that you have reviewed and agree to Jasper's CCPA Notice to Candidates, available at legal.jasper.ai/#ccpa.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, IQ
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Jasper is the marketing agents platform, built to help enterprises orchestrate AI agents that execute marketing work at scale. Purpose-built for marketing teams, Jasper enables faster, more consistent execution across campaigns, personalization, localization, and compliance—while maintaining enterprise-grade control and governance.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S., Australia, and France.

About The Role

As a Staff Software Engineer at Jasper, you will drive the technical vision and architecture for the integration pod within our IQ team. Integrations are how Jasper securely accesses and activates data from external systems — like Salesforce and HubSpot — and that data powers our IQ layer, which is critical to the quality and consistency of the output that sits on top of our LLM experiences. In short, the systems you architect directly shape how good, how trustworthy, and how differentiated Jasper's AI output is for our customers.

This is a high-leverage role. You'll set the technical direction for how we ingest and model external data, navigate the real-world constraints of connecting to many disparate systems (API limits, security and compliance concerns, customer-specific requirements), and define the context primitives in the IQ layer that depend on that data. Beyond your own initiatives, you'll set the bar for engineering excellence on the team, help chart the right sequence of projects and architectural goals, and contribute to the broader org-level technical vision.

This is a fully remote role and is open to candidates located anywhere in the continental US.

What you will do at Jasper

  • Own the technical vision and architecture for the integration pod, defining how Jasper connects to and ingests data from external systems such as Salesforce and HubSpot

  • Architect data ingestion and integration systems that account for the differing constraints of each external system — including API rate limits, authentication, and security concerns

  • Design and evolve the context primitives in the IQ layer that depend on external data, and scope the additional engineering work needed to support them

  • Partner across the team to address customer-specific integration and design concerns, translating unique requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions

  • Proactively understand the business needs of the team, produce a concrete plan of action, and drive it to completion — setting an example for how staff-level work gets done

  • Help the team navigate the right set of next projects and architectural goals, and contribute to the org-level technical vision as needed

  • Research and propose concrete plans for architectural improvements and upgrades, weighing trade-offs and building alignment across stakeholders

What you will bring to Jasper

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of operating at a staff/principal level of scope and influence

  • Demonstrated experience leading major technical initiatives to the finish line — and having stayed long enough afterward to understand and articulate their real-world consequences and trade-offs

  • Deep expertise in designing and building integration and data-ingestion systems that connect to multiple external systems with differing constraints (API limits, authentication, security, and compliance)

  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals and the ability to architect for reliability, scalability, and maintainability

  • AI fluency — a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, copilots, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied in the context of building and architecting AI-powered engineering systems

  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset: you identify what the business needs, produce a concrete plan, and execute — while raising the bar for those around you

  • Excellent technical judgment and communication skills, with the ability to align teams and stakeholders around architectural direction

  • Familiarity with the systems and tools that marketers rely on (e.g., CRMs and marketing platforms like Salesforce and HubSpot) — though this can also be learned on the job

  • Experience building the data foundations that power LLM-based or AI-driven product experiences

Compensation Range

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $238,000 - $280,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage beginning on the first day for employees and their families

  • 401(k) program with up to 2% company matching

  • Equity grant participation

  • Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work

  • FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals

  • Generous budget for home office set up

  • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels as we know the more inclusive we are, the better our product will be. We are committed to celebrating and supporting our differences and that diversity is essential to innovation and makes us better able to serve our customers. We hire people of all levels and backgrounds who are excited to learn and develop their skills. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S., Australia, and France.

As a Senior Security Engineer at Jasper, you'll be the first true generalist on our Security Engineering team—someone equally comfortable securing and building AI agents and platforms as they are automating GRC controls or hardening cloud infrastructure. This role sits at the center of a fast-moving security function, partnering closely with Engineering, GRC, Product, and IT to protect the systems and AI products Jasper builds.

You'll set technical direction on AI security while still being hands-on across infrastructure, product security, and compliance engineering—a true jack-of-all-trades role that flexes across the full security spectrum as priorities shift. This is a force-multiplier position on a small team where your work will have outsized impact on how Jasper builds securely at scale.

This fully remote role reports to the Director, Security and is open to candidates located anywhere in the US.

What you will do at Jasper

  • Lead the security design, implementation, and controls for Jasper’s AI infrastructure and AI-powered internal workflows—building the guardrails that govern how AI systems access, process, and handle sensitive data at every layer

  • Own threat modeling for AI-specific risks, including the attack surfaces that don’t map cleanly onto traditional application security, and design controls for validating, logging, and auditing AI outputs where accuracy and data protection are non-negotiable

  • Build security tooling and automated checks that let internal teams adopt AI capabilities without slowing down

  • Collaborate, design, and influence the direction of the Security program at Jasper

  • Work with the GRC team to build and maintain GRC-related engineering—automating evidence collection, control monitoring, and compliance workflows (ie. via Vanta or similar) so the team spends less time on manual audit prep

  • Strengthen infrastructure security across GCP and AWS: identity and access management, network segmentation, secrets management, and secure-by-default infrastructure patterns

  • Own and improve GitHub security controls—branch protection, required reviews, secret scanning, dependency/SCA policies, and CI/CD pipeline security

  • Operate and tune Wiz (or equivalent CSPM/CNAPP tooling) to continuously identify and drive remediation of cloud misconfigurations and vulnerabilities

  • Use AI tools heavily in your own workflow (code review, triage, detection engineering, documentation) and help the broader security and engineering org do the same safely, while partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Legal, Product, IT, and GRC to translate security and compliance requirements into practical, low-friction engineering solutions

What you will bring to Jasper

  • AI fluency—a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, copilots, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied in the context of security engineering, with demonstrated enthusiasm for using AI tools to work faster and more effectively day to day

  • 8+ years in security engineering, with hands-on experience across at least two of: AI/ML security, cloud infrastructure security, and/or GRC compliance engineering

  • Practical experience securing AI systems—LLM applications, agents, or ML pipelines—including familiarity with common AI-specific threats (prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse, insecure tool use)

  • Deep understanding of security principles, best practices, and common vulnerabilities, including strong security judgment under ambiguity

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify, prioritize, and address security gaps or inefficiencies through automation and tooling

  • Expertise and curiosity about using frontier models and agents to effectively solve security challenges

  • Demonstrated ability to build security programs, processes, or standards from scratch rather than inheriting a mature playbook

  • Strong working knowledge of GCP and AWS security services and IAM models

  • Experience with GitHub security controls (branch protection, secret scanning, Actions/CI security) and secure software supply chain practices

  • Hands-on experience with Wiz or a comparable CSPM/CNAPP platform

  • Comfort building automation and tooling (scripting, APIs, infrastructure-as-code) rather than relying solely on point-and-click console work

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who can communicate security and compliance tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

  • Direct experience building or securing AI agent frameworks, agent tool-calling systems, or internal AI platforms

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or similar compliance frameworks and working with GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata)

  • Background in detection engineering or building internal security tooling

  • Experience being an early or first specialized hire on a small security team, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • Experience working in AI infrastructure platforms (e.g., Modal, CoreWeave, etc.)

Compensation Range

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $174,250 - $205,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage beginning on the first day for employees and their families

  • 401(k) program with up to 2% company matching

  • Equity grant participation

  • Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work

  • FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals

  • Generous budget for home office set up

  • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels as we know the more inclusive we are, the better our product will be. We are committed to celebrating and supporting our differences and that diversity is essential to innovation and makes us better able to serve our customers. We hire people of all levels and backgrounds who are excited to learn and develop their skills. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

You’ll lead a high-performing team and pioneer how AI transforms modern growth marketing—from campaign execution and personalization to experimentation, measurement, and optimization.

Build a unified growth engine that accelerates pipeline across our enterprise sales motion and leverages AI to continuously improve speed, personalization, and performance.

Run World-Class Enterprise Marketing Programs

  • Lead Jasper’s field marketing and account-based marketing strategy, bringing together executive events, customer engagement, digital campaigns, and sales plays into a cohesive enterprise growth motion.

  • Partner closely with Sales to create high-impact programs that build relationships, accelerate pipeline, and expand strategic accounts.

Partner Deeply with Sales

  • Work as one team with Sales leadership to define target accounts, build account-based programs, prioritize investment, and drive predictable pipeline generation and expansion.

  • Own Marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue.

  • Partner closely with GTM Operations and Data Science to continuously improve the systems that power growth, including lead and account scoring, routing, attribution, funnel measurement, and account prioritization—ensuring Sales and Marketing are aligned around the highest-value opportunities.

  • Lead a multidisciplinary team spanning performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, and organic growth.

  • Coach leaders, raise the quality bar, and build a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning.

What you will bring to Jasper

  • 10+ years leading B2B SaaS growth or revenue marketing, including experience supporting enterprise sales motions.

  • A track record of building pipeline through integrated digital, lifecycle, and ABMprograms.

  • Deep expertise in performance marketing, paid acquisition, website optimization, CRO, and modern growth strategy.

  • Experience partnering closely with Sales leadership on account strategy, forecasting, and revenue planning.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to diagnose problems, prioritize investment, and improve funnel performance.

  • Experience building and scaling high-performing marketing teams while remaining close enough to the work to coach and contribute.

  • A strategic mindset paired with a hands-on operating style—you enjoy moving between executive planning and campaign execution.

  • Curiosity about AI and a demonstrated ability to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve how marketing works.

  • Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence across marketing, sales, customer success, and executive leadership.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Help define how enterprise marketing teams adopt and scale AI.

  • Own one of the most important growth functions in the company.

  • Work alongside a talented team that values speed, curiosity, creativity, and measurable impact.

  • Shape the future of marketing at one of the leading AI companies in the market.

  • Oversee corporate card transactions, employee expense reimbursements, and accounts payable workflows utilizing Ramp

 - Lead an accurate and timely month-end close by preparing journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations across cash, prepaids, accruals, intercompany, fixed assets, and other general ledger accounts

 - Manage close workflows, task tracking, and balance sheet reconciliations within Numeric to drive close efficiency and transparency

 - Oversee corporate card transactions, employee expense reimbursements, and accounts payable workflows utilizing Ramp

 - Reconcile subscription billing, SaaS metrics, and payment gateway transactions within Maxio

 - Maintain equity transaction records, stock-based compensation schedules, and capitalization table reporting in Carta

 - Oversee monthly variable compensation calculations and proper accounting treatment (ASC 340)

 - Ensure accounting records, policies, and operational processes adhere strictly to US GAAP and maintain sound internal controls

 - Partner cross-functionally across departments to capture transaction details, investigate reconciling items, and resolve operational variances

 - Support the annual financial statement audit, tax filings, and external compliance requirements

 - Assist with ad-hoc financial reporting, system enhancements, and special projects as needed




WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO JASPER 

 - AI fluency — a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, copilots, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied in the context of accounting, financial operations, and workflow automation

 - Active CPA license (required)

 - 3+ years of progressive general ledger accounting experience, ideally in a fast-paced technology or high-growth SaaS environment

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field of study

 - Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, month-end close procedures, and account reconciliation best practices

 - Direct, hands-on experience with modern cloud ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)

 - Direct experience working with modern financial and accounting tooling (such as Ramp for spend management, Numeric for close management, Maxio for SaaS billing/revenue, and Carta for equity administration) or comparable platforms

 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

 - High attention to detail and ability to operate independently with minimal direction

 - Prior public accounting experience (Big 4 or national firm) strongly preferred

 - Exposure to technical accounting areas (e.g., ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 340 capitalized commissions, equity accounting) is a plus
